parsed_entries.requirement: The Information Commission has the same powers as a civil court while trying a suit under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, in matters related to the inquiry process.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Information Commission has the same powers as a civil court in inquiry processes.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the procedural powers of the Information Commission during inquiries.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Information Commission may issue summons for the examination of witnesses or documents.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Information Commission is authorized to issue summons for witness examination or document retrieval.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause grants the Information Commission the authority to summon witnesses or documents during inquiries.

parsed_entries.requirement: An appeal against a decision of the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer must be filed within the time specified in sub-section (3) of section 7.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the appeal period for decisions by Public Information Officers is adhered to.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause sets the time limit for filing appeals against Public Information Officer decisions.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Information Commission must provide a reasonable opportunity of being heard to third parties involved in an appeal.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if third parties are given a reasonable opportunity to be heard during appeals.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause ensures that third parties have a fair opportunity to present their case during appeals.

parsed_entries.requirement: An appeal under sub-section (3) or (2) must be disposed of within thirty days, with an additional fifteen days if needed.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Information Commission disposes of appeals within the prescribed time limits.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause sets the time limits for resolving appeals under the RTI Act 2005.

parsed_entries.requirement: The decision of the Information Commission is binding on all parties involved.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Information Commission's decision is binding on all parties.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause establishes the finality of the Information Commission's decisions.
